_about: Ground truth for calibrating the validator against ONE application. For each class: the file, the exact text to replace, and what to replace it with to make a hand-written correct fix, an overfitted fix (blocks only the exact payload) and a gutted fix (removes the feature). Test fixtures, like the answer key: the engine never reads this file, and the calibration harness has no knowledge of any application beyond it. `blind_spots` lists cases the validator is known to be unable to tell, with the reason.

fixed: const u = req.query.url; if (typeof u === 'string' && /^\/(?![\/\\])/.test(u)) { return res.redirect(u); } return res.redirect('/dashboard');
const url = req.query.url + req.query.symbol; if (!/^https:\/\/finance\.yahoo\.com\//.test(url)) { return res.status(400).send('invalid url'); }
overfit: const url = req.query.url + req.query.symbol; if (url.includes('127.0.0.1')) { return res.status(400).send('blocked'); }
gutted: const url = req.query.url + req.query.symbol; return res.status(400).send('disabled');
